description: This file defines React context and provider components for the Keystone admin UI, including data fetching, global styles, and hooks for accessing Keystone data structures.

methods.name: InternalKeystoneProvider
methods.description: React component that provides Keystone context, manages data fetching for meta info, and sets global styles.

methods.name: KeystoneProvider
methods.description: Wraps the internal provider with Apollo client setup for GraphQL communication.

methods.name: useKeystone
methods.description: Hook to access the Keystone context.

methods.name: useList
methods.description: Hook to access a specific list's metadata.

methods.name: useField
methods.description: Hook to access a specific field's metadata within a list.

methods.name: useListItem
methods.description: Hook to fetch a specific list item by ID, returning GraphQL query result.
